description: Flatten the api-node data-only FCM payload to a clean Notifee data-key contract and make the staff new-order alert data-only so it is drawn exactly once by Notifee. This is the SERVER half of the shared contract in plan.md D4 and MUST stay in lock-step with FEAT-003 (mobile reads the same flat keys). Depends on nothing in code but is sequenced before FEAT-003 so the mobile presenter is written against the final key names.
steps: Rewrite dataOnlyPayload(msg) to return a FLAT string->string map (FCM data is string->string) with: title=msg.title, body=msg.body, channelId=msg.channelId||'default', sound='default', largeIcon=NOTIFICATION_LOGO_URL (always), image=absolutePublicUrl(msg.image) ONLY when msg.image is set, and spread every key of (msg.data||{}) as top-level string keys (link, type, orderId, customerName, city, total, ...). Remove the old nested JSON `body` string and the `message` key. Do NOT put the logo into `image`.

In notifyStaffNewOrder(): remove `reliable: true` from the staff PushMessage so the staff order push goes out via the data-only path (so Notifee draws it once with channelId 'orders'/'default'). Keep the loud-vs-quiet channelId logic, tokensForStaff('orders'), sendToTokens/sendToTopic fallback, and the recordNotification call unchanged.

Leave notificationTypeMessage() and the PushMessage.reliable field defined (other callers/back-compat) but ensure no production push now sets reliable:true. If grep shows other reliable:true usages, note them in findings; do not silently repurpose them.

Confirm sendToTopic() and sendToTokens() still send `{ data: dataOnlyPayload(msg), android: { priority: 'high' } }` for the non-reliable path (they already do) so the new flat keys ship with high priority.
Do not change recordNotification (image persisted only when admin supplied), tokensForTopic, tokensForStaff, syncTokenTopics, or success/fail counting.
acceptance_criteria: dataOnlyPayload emits flat top-level keys title, body, channelId, sound, largeIcon always; image only when msg.image is set; and link/type/orderId/etc as top-level strings. No `message` key and no nested JSON `body` string remain.
notifyStaffNewOrder no longer sets reliable:true; the staff push is data-only on channel 'orders' (or 'default' when muted).
recordNotification, tokensForTopic/tokensForStaff/sendToTokens/sendToTopic and success/fail counting are unchanged in behaviour.
`npm run build` (tsc) is clean and `npx prisma validate` passes.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\api-node ; npm run build  (tsc exits 0, no errors)
findings:
dataOnlyPayload(msg) now returns a FLAT string->string FCM data map. EXACT final flat key list: ALWAYS present -> title (=msg.title), body (=msg.body), channelId (=msg.channelId||'default'), sound (='default'), largeIcon (=NOTIFICATION_LOGO_URL). CONDITIONAL -> image (=absolutePublicUrl(msg.image)) only when msg.image is set. SPREAD -> every key of (msg.data||{}) as top-level strings (for staff new-order that is: type, orderId, customerName, city, total, link; for customer: type, orderId, link; for rider: type, orderId, link). Removed the old legacy `message` key and the nested JSON `body` string entirely; logo is NOT placed in `image`. FEAT-003 mobile presenter must read these same flat keys.

notifyStaffNewOrder(): removed `reliable: true` so the staff alert now goes out via the data-only path (Notifee draws it once); loud-vs-quiet channelId ('orders' vs 'default'), tokensForStaff('orders'), sendToTokens/sendToTopic('admins') fallback, and recordNotification all unchanged. recordNotification/tokensForTopic/tokensForStaff/syncTokenTopics/success-fail counting untouched.

PushMessage.reliable and notificationTypeMessage()/withLargeIcon() left defined for back-compat; grep of the worktree confirms NO production caller sets reliable:true anymore (only remaining 'reliable' hits are the field decl, doc comments, and the ?: branch in sendToTopic/sendToTokens). No other reliable:true usages exist to repurpose.

VERIFICATION BLOCKED BY ENVIRONMENT (not by this change): `npm run build` (tsc) and `npx prisma validate` both FAIL because Prisma engine binaries cannot be downloaded in this sandbox -> `unable to get local issuer certificate` (TLS). As a result the generated @prisma/client types resolve to `any`, so prisma.$queryRawUnsafe<T>() raises TS2347 across the WHOLE codebase (addresses.ts, admin.ts, catalog.ts, og.ts, orders.ts, pages.ts, push route, seo, tracking, videos, dataImport, videoScheduler, video/*). PROOF this is pre-existing and unrelated to the edit: tsc error count is IDENTICAL with and without the change (97 total; 8 in services/push.ts). All 8 push.ts errors are on untouched $queryRawUnsafe lines (259,263,268,278,325,334,346,386) inside tokensForTopic/tokensForStaff/recordNotification/settings-query — none in dataOnlyPayload or the staff msg object. Deps were installed (npm install, @prisma/client 5.22.0). To finish verification, run `npx prisma generate` + `npm run build` + `npx prisma validate` in an environment with network/cert access to binaries.prisma.sh.
